newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles says performance at 94/95 level.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles says performance at 94/95 level.

text.p: Australian retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Tbursday that its performance had recovered to the levels of 1994/95, one of its most profitable years.
"Our performance has recovered to the level of 1995, or in effect exceeded 1995 which was a very good year for the company," chief executive Dennis Eck told reporters.
"We see this as a very good first step on a road to recovery and ultimately you judge a business not by one result," he said.
"You judge a business by sustained performance over time."
Coles reported a 40.7 percent increase in net profit after abnormals to A$273.6 million for the 26 weeks to January 26.
In 1994/95, Coles reported a net profit of A$423.4 million.
